create.name: Yokoji Zen Mountain Center
create.bio:
Yokoji Zen Mountain Center is a year-round Zen training temple set on 160 wild acres in the San Jacinto Mountains above Mountain Center, Southern California. Taizan Maezumi Roshi founded it in 1982 as the summer retreat site of the Zen Center of Los Angeles, and several of his successors trained here before it became a full-time centre in 1995. The name means sunlight temple, fitting for a community that lives off the grid on solar and wind power and draws its water from its own wells.

The abbot, Charles Tenshin Fletcher Roshi, grew up in Manchester and moved to Los Angeles in 1979 to train with Maezumi, who gave him dharma transmission in the White Plum line in 1994. He is a certified overseas teacher of the Soto school and co-wrote the introductory book Way of Zen. In keeping with his lineage he teaches both koan study and shikantaza.

Visitors can start with the Sunday morning programme of zazen instruction, sitting, a dharma talk and lunch. The calendar runs a sesshin nearly every month, from weekend introductions to week-long retreats, plus two month-long training periods a year. Guests may stay a few nights and follow the daily schedule, longer-term residents can train for months, and Tenshin Roshi's talks go out as a free monthly podcast.

courses.title: Sesshin (Rohatsu)
courses.description: A seven-day residential silent retreat of zazen, chanting services, formal meals and work practice, with daily dharma talks and private interviews. First-timers should first attend a Sunday programme or a weekend Beginner's Mind Sesshin; experienced sitters may join part-time.

courses.title: Beginner's Mind Sesshin
courses.description: A weekend retreat for newcomers that teaches the basics of zazen and lets them sit alongside experienced practitioners; no previous Zen experience is needed.

courses.title: Stay at Yokoji
courses.description: Overnight stays of up to three nights (six for members) following the daily schedule, with free afternoons to sit, read or hike; contact the office before applying.

courses.title: Membership
courses.description: Annual membership with private interviews with the teachers, the quarterly journal, one free night a month and half-price lodging; higher pledge levels include free sesshin and extra overnight stays.
courses.price: Friend of Yokoji Annual pledge $1,200 for individuals. $1,800 for families. Temple Guardian Annual pledge $3,600 for individuals. $5,400 for families.

free_resources.title: Yokoji Podcast
free_resources.description: Monthly dharma talks by Tenshin Roshi on koans from the Blue Cliff Record, Dogen and the Precious Mirror Samadhi, free to stream or download.

free_resources.title: Zazen (Zen Meditation)
free_resources.description: A video and written guide to sitting postures, counting and following the breath, and the two practices of koan and shikantaza.
